review_description: Clean Power Co quoted low. Tried to charge $8000 more than their quote. Installed without my consent. System does none of the things they said it would do and they forged my signature on a direct debit form with the finance company. Now they are completely uncontactable. I have lodged a report with ACCC Scamwatch.
Ripped off!!! Paid 15k over 4yrs and my bills are $750!!!Can't even get in touch with them!!!
Installation product are good. Companies info on savings a load of rubbish it costs money to have, not saving on power at all.

I found that initial quotes were very high, so high I would describe them as 'rip-offs', but I did my homework and shopped around, in terms of both price and quality of products. I got a good price in the end, but had to spend a good deal of time getting there. AND I'm happy with the outcome.
